cases.purpose: Assert capability denial and diagnostics, no-op removal, privileged immutable and append effects, and cleanup after a failing inner script. Independent cleanup runs on shell exit.
cases.oracle: e2fsprogs chattr and lsattr on private ext4
cases.comparison: Byte parity of denied-operation diagnostics and success marker; explicit assertions fail if either side lacks required behavior or prerequisites.
cases.script:
set -eu
I=/tmp/chattr-capability-regression.img M=/tmp/chattr-capability-regression-mnt
mounted=0
cleanup() {
  rc=$?
  trap - EXIT
  if (( mounted )); then
    /usr/bin/chattr -R -ia "$M" || rc=1
    for f in "$M/f" "$M/g"; do
      if [[ -e $f ]]; then
        flags=$(/usr/bin/lsattr -d "$f") || rc=1
        attrs=${flags%% *}
        [[ $attrs != *i* && $attrs != *a* ]] || rc=1
      fi
    done
    cd /tmp/parity-case
    /usr/bin/umount "$M" || rc=1
  fi
  /usr/bin/rm -f "$I"
  /usr/bin/rmdir "$M" 2>/dev/null || :
  exit "$rc"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
/usr/bin/truncate -s 4M "$I"
/usr/sbin/mkfs.ext4 -q -F -O ^has_journal "$I"
/usr/bin/mkdir "$M"
/usr/bin/mount -o loop "$I" "$M"
mounted=1
cd "$M"
printf 'a\n' > f; printf 'a\n' > g
/usr/bin/chown 2000:2000 f g
/usr/bin/chmod 0777 .
attrs() { local x; x=$(/usr/bin/lsattr -d "$1"); printf '%s' "${x%% *}"; }
no_flags() { local x; x=$(attrs "$1"); [[ $x != *i* && $x != *a* ]]; }
for flag in i a; do
  rc=0
  /usr/bin/setpriv --reuid=2000 --regid=2000 --clear-groups -- "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c "chattr +$flag f" >/tmp/chattr-cap.out 2>/tmp/chattr-cap.err || rc=$?
  [[ $rc != 0 && -s /tmp/chattr-cap.err && ! -s /tmp/chattr-cap.out ]]
  printf 'denied +%s status=%s diagnostic=' "$flag" "$rc"
  /usr/bin/sed -E 's/^[^:]*: line [0-9]+: //' /tmp/chattr-cap.err
  no_flags f
  /usr/bin/setpriv --reuid=2000 --regid=2000 --clear-groups -- "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c "chattr -$flag f" >/tmp/chattr-cap.out 2>/tmp/chattr-cap.err
  [[ ! -s /tmp/chattr-cap.out && ! -s /tmp/chattr-cap.err ]]
  no_flags f
done
chattr +i f
[[ $(attrs f) == *i* ]]
if (echo more >> f) 2>/dev/null; then exit 1; fi
if /usr/bin/rm -f f 2>/dev/null; then exit 1; fi
[[ -e f ]]
chattr -i f
no_flags f
chattr +a g
[[ $(attrs g) == *a* ]]
if (echo over > g) 2>/dev/null; then exit 1; fi
echo more >> g
[[ $(<g) == $'a\nmore' ]]
chattr -a g
no_flags g
rc=0
"$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c 'chattr +i f && chattr +a g && exit 3' || rc=$?
[[ $rc == 3 && $(attrs f) == *i* && $(attrs g) == *a* ]]
chattr -R -ia .
no_flags f; no_flags g
printf 'capability, effects and failing-script cleanup verified\n'
